I've created a legally sound offer letter for a Senior Software Engineer position and saved it to **`senior-software-engineer-offer-letter.md`** in the workspace.

## What's Included

Based on the standard offer-letter template, the document covers:

- **Position details** — title, reporting line, location, start date, employment type
- **Role summary** — architecture, mentoring, code quality, and collaboration expectations
- **Compensation** — base salary, discretionary bonus, and equity award structure
- **Benefits** — health coverage, 401(k), PTO, holidays, and development stipend
- **Contingencies** — background check, work authorization, and standard confidentiality/IP assignment agreements
- **At-will language** — clear statement that no employment contract or fixed-term guarantee is created
- **Acceptance section** — signature blocks for the candidate
- **Disclaimer** — noting the document is informational and should be reviewed by legal counsel

## Key Notes

- The placeholders (candidate name, salary, vesting schedule, dates) are in **[brackets]** so you can customize them before sending.
- I used **standard, enforceable provisions only** — including a customary confidentiality/IP assignment reference and neutral at-will language — and deliberately did **not** include any restrictions that would be unenforceable or contrary to legal best practices (such as clauses limiting lawful reporting, overly broad non-competes, or wage deductions tied to company losses).

Would you like me to:
1. Fill it in with specific details (company name, candidate name, salary, etc.)?
2. Add a companion **Confidentiality and IP Assignment Agreement**?
3. Adjust for a specific jurisdiction (e.g., California, which restricts non-competes)?

arguments.content:
# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at **[COMPANY NAME]**. Your background in designing scalable systems and mentoring engineering teams will be a valuable addition to our organization.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [Manager Name/Title]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, [Exempt/Non-Exempt]
**Work Schedule:** [Standard hours / Flexible core hours]

## Responsibilities (Summary)

In this role, you will be expected to:
- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable software systems
- Lead technical design reviews and contribute to architecture decisions
- Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers
- Collaborate with product, design, and cross-functional teams
- Champion code quality, testing, and engineering best practices
- Participate in on-call rotation and incident response as needed

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per [year], paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly/monthly] in accordance with our standard payroll schedule, subject to applicable withholdings.

**Bonus:** You will be eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance.

**Equity:** Subject to approval and plan terms, you will be granted [X] stock options / RSUs, vesting over [4] years with a [1]-year cliff, under a separate equity award agreement.

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, including:
- Health insurance (medical, dental, vision), effective [date]
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off per year
- [X] paid holidays
- Professional development stipend
- [Other benefits, e.g., remote work equipment budget]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:
- Successful completion of a background check
- Verification of your legal right to work in [Country]
- Execution of standard employment documents, including:
  - Confidentiality and IP Assignment Agreement
  - Conflict of Interest / Outside Activities disclosure
  - [Other standard agreements as applicable]

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, for any lawful reason. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period and creates no guarantee of future employment.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return it by [DEADLINE DATE]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our team. If you have any questions, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

*This document is a template for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Consult with qualified legal counsel before finalizing any employment documentation.*
